prompt: Create a faithful square reproduction of a late-19th-century oil on canvas portrait, preserving a vertical composition centered in the square. Show the head and upper torso of a young girl emerging from an unfinished pale garment. Her dark hair is loosely gathered back; her head tilts slightly to her right while she looks outward with large grey-brown eyes and small red lips. The face is softly modeled with peach and pink tones against a muted olive-grey and cream background. Leave the lower portion sketchy and unresolved, with thin underdrawing at right. Use delicate, powdery brushwork, visible canvas weave, subdued light, and a slightly aged varnished surface.
